ProgramUnit.Name: TOOLBAR
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PACKAGE BODY TOOLBAR IS

 cs VARCHAR2(20);
 csscale NUMBER;

 PROCEDURE hide_function IS
 BEGIN
 Set_Item_Property('banner.TEXT',DISPLAYED,PROPERTY_OFF);
 IF NOT Id_Null(Find_Timer('ENTER_TOOLBAR')) THEN
 Delete_Timer('ENTER_TOOLBAR');
 END IF;
 END; /* hide_function */

 PROCEDURE set_timer IS
 t Timer;
 BEGIN
 :banner.system_name := :SYSTEM.MOUSE_ITEM;
 IF NOT Id_Null(Find_Timer('ENTER_TOOLBAR')) THEN
 Delete_Timer('ENTER_TOOLBAR');
 END IF;
 t := Create_Timer('ENTER_TOOLBAR',250,NO_REPEAT);
 END; /* set_timer */

 PROCEDURE show_function IS
 w NUMBER;
 BEGIN
 :toolbar.Text := Get_Item_Property(item_name, LABEL);
 w := dll.tblen(:toolbar.text)*tbscale/100000*csscale;
 Set_Item_Property('TOOLBAR.TEXT',WIDTH,w);
 Set_Item_Property('TOOLBAR.TEXT',POSITION,
 to_number(Get_Item_Property(item_name,X_POS)),
 to_number(Get_Item_Property(item_name,Y_POS)) +
 to_number(Get_Item_Property(item_name,HEIGHT)));
 Set_Item_Property('TOOLBAR.TEXT',DISPLAYED,PROPERTY_ON);
 END; /* show_function */

BEGIN

 cs := Get_Form_Property(Get_Application_Property(CURRENT_FORM_NAME),COORDINATE_SYSTEM);
 IF cs = 'INCHES' THEN csscale := 1;
 ELSIF cs = 'PIXELS' THEN csscale := 120;
 ELSIF cs = 'POINTS' THEN csscale := 72;
 ELSIF cs = 'CENTIMETERS' THEN csscale := 2.56;
 ELSIF cs = 'CHARACTER_CELL' THEN
 csscale := Get_Form_Property(Get_Application_Property(CURRENT_FORM_NAME),CHARACTER_CELL_WIDTH);
 csscale := 140/csscale;
 END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: DUP_INSERT_RG
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE dup_insert_rg(plCellType in varchar2, plEDATE in varchar2,plTDATE in varchar2) IS
 rg_name VARCHAR2(20) := 'CELL'; 
 rg_col1 VARCHAR2(20) := 'CELL.CTYPE'; 
 rg_col2 VARCHAR2(20) := 'CELL.EDATE'; 
 rg_col3 VARCHAR2(20) := 'CELL.TDATE'; 
 rg_id RecordGroup; 
 gc_id GroupColumn; 
 rowcount NUMBER; 
 DUP_RECORD VARCHAR2(1):='N';
 VCount NUMBER:=0;
BEGIN 
 select nvl(count(*),0) into vCount from valid_elig_cell_loss where
 chapter_id=:global.chapter_id and cell_type=plCellType and
 eff_date=to_date(plEDATE,'mm-dd-yyyy') and
 sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1);
IF vCount > 0 then 
 show_error('13002');
 check_package_failure; 
ELSE 
 rg_id := Find_Group( rg_name ); 
 IF NOT Id_Null(rg_id) THEN 
 rowcount:=GET_GROUP_ROW_COUNT('CELL');
 
 FOR i in 1 .. rowcount Loop
 If Get_Group_Char_cell(rg_col1,i) = plCellType AND
 Get_Group_Char_cell(rg_col2,i) = plEDATE then
 DUP_RECORD:='Y'; 
 exit;
 End if; 
 End Loop;

 If DUP_RECORD ='Y' then 
 show_error('13002');
 check_package_failure; 
 Else
 Add_Group_Row( rg_id, END_OF_GROUP ); 
 Set_Group_Char_Cell( rg_col1, rowcount+1, plCellType); 
 Set_Group_Char_Cell( rg_col2, rowcount+1, plEDATE); 
 Set_Group_Char_Cell( rg_col3, rowcount+1, plTDATE); 
 End if;
 END IF; 

END IF;

END;

ProgramUnit.Name: DUP_REC_VALIDATION
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE dup_rec_validation IS
 v_ctype VARCHAR2(5):=RTrim(LTrim(:global.ctype));
 v_date DATE:=to_date(RTrim(LTrim(:global.eff_date)),'mm-dd-yyyy');
 v_tdate DATE:=to_date(RTrim(LTrim(:global.term_date)),'mm-dd-yyyy');
BEGIN

 If :valid_elig_cell_loss.cell_type is not null and :valid_elig_cell_loss.eff_date is not null
 Then 
 If not check_existing_data then
 If :valid_elig_cell_loss.term_date is null or :valid_elig_cell_loss.term_date > sysdate then
 If db_check(:valid_elig_cell_loss.cell_type,to_char(:valid_elig_cell_loss.eff_date,'mm-dd-yyyy'))
 Then
 show_error('13002');
 check_package_failure; 
 Else
 
 If NVL(:valid_elig_cell_loss.cell_type,'') !=NVL(v_ctype,'') OR
 NVL(:valid_elig_cell_loss.eff_date,'') !=v_date 
 Then
 
 If v_ctype is not null and v_date is not null then
 DUP_DELETE_RG(v_ctype,to_char(v_date),to_char(v_tdate));
 End if;
 End if; 
 DUP_INSERT_RG(:valid_elig_cell_loss.cell_type,to_char(:valid_elig_cell_loss.eff_date,'mm-dd-yyyy'),
 to_char(:valid_elig_cell_loss.term_date,'mm-dd-yyyy')); 
 End if; 
 End if;
 End if;
End if;
END;

Trigger.Name: ON-ERROR
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 procedure format_error is
 temp_format varchar2(100);
 temp_pos number;
 begin
 temp_format := upper(GET_ITEM_PROPERTY(:system.cursor_item,FORMAT_MASK));
 -- remove FM or FX format prefix
 if substr(temp_format,1,2) in ('FX','FM') then
 temp_format := substr(temp_format,3);
 end if;
 -- remove double quotes and change 0 to 9
 temp_format := translate(temp_format,'0"','9');
 -- change HH24 to HH
 temp_pos := instr(temp_format,'HH24');
 if temp_pos != 0 then
 temp_format := substr(temp_format,1,temp_pos-1)||'HH'||
 substr(temp_format,temp_pos + 4);
 end if;
 -- change multiple RR to YY
 loop
 temp_pos := instr(temp_format,'RR');
 exit when temp_pos = 0;
 temp_format := substr(temp_format,1,temp_pos-1)||'YY'||
 substr(temp_format,temp_pos + 2);
 end loop;
 show_error('0022',temp_format );
 check_package_failure;
 end;

 ---------- Following added by Mukesh 05/28 --------------

 then

 then

 ----------------------------------------------------------

 then
